content: oṃ āḥ hūṃ vajra guru padma siddhi hūṃI pray to the Dharmakāya Amitābha.I pray to the Sambhogakāya, the Great Compassionate One.I pray to the Nirmāṇakāya Padmasambhava.My Guru is a wondrous emanation body;Born in the land of India, you engaged in listening and reflection.Arriving in Central Tibet, you subjugated the arrogant spirits.Residing in the land of Oḍḍiyāna, you act for the benefit of beings.When the wonders of your form are seen:Your right hand makes the mudrā of the sword,Your left hand makes the mudrā of summoning,With mouth agape and fangs bared, you gaze upward.Heir of the Victors, protector of beings.Through your compassion, grant me your blessings.Through your love, lead me and others along the path.Through your enlightened intent, grant me the accomplishments.Through your power, dispel the obstacles for me and others.Dispel outer obstacles externally.Dispel inner obstacles internally.Dispel secret obstacles into the basic expanse.With devotion, I prostrate and go for refuge.oṃ āḥ hūṃ vajra guru padma siddhi hūṃWhen you listened to the precious, sublime Dharma,Your body was luminous, possessing a radiant luster.In your right hand, you held the volumes of the Piṭakas,In your left, you held the texts of Kīlaya.You realized the profound teachings within your heart,O Paṇḍita of Yangleshö.Through your compassion, grant me your blessings.Through your love, lead me and others along the path.Through your enlightened intent, grant me the accomplishments.Through your power, dispel the obstacles for me and others.Dispel outer obstacles externally.Dispel inner obstacles internally.Dispel secret obstacles into the basic expanse.With devotion, I prostrate and go for refuge.oṃ āḥ hūṃ vajra guru padma siddhi hūṃWhen you bound the oath-bound guardians to your command,In that stainless, supreme site, so delightful to the mind,On the border between India and Tibet,You arrived, having bestowed your blessings.Upon that mountain filled with the fragrance of incense,Lotus flowers bloom even in winter.The spring water is the nectar of enlightenment;In that supreme, blissful sacred place,Supreme Being of excellent conduct, clad in Dharma robes,In your right hand, you hold a nine-pointed vajra,And a precious casket in your left,Filled within with rakta and nectar.You bound the ḍākinīs and oath-bound spirits under oath,Beheld the faces of your meditational deities, and attained accomplishments.Through your compassion, grant me your blessings.Through your love, lead me and others along the path.Through your enlightened intent, grant me the accomplishments.Through your power, dispel the obstacles for me and others.Dispel outer obstacles externally.Dispel inner obstacles internally.Dispel secret obstacles into the basic expanse.With devotion, I prostrate and go for refuge.oṃ āḥ hūṃ vajra guru padma siddhi hūṃWhen you established the teachings of the Victorious One,You performed spiritual practice in the forests of the slate mountains.Your ritual dagger soared into the expanse of the sky;Catching it with a vajra mudra, you rolled it between your palms.Rolling it, you hurled it into the sandalwood forest;Blazing fires raged and even the oceans were parched.The tirthikas of the dark slopes and the entire land were incinerated,And the black yakṣas were ground into dust.Peerless one, the slayer of Māras:Through your compassion, grant me your blessings.Through your love, lead me and others along the path.Through your enlightened intent, grant me the accomplishments.Through your power, dispel the obstacles for me and others.Dispel outer obstacles externally.Dispel inner obstacles internally.Dispel secret obstacles into the basic expanse.With devotion, I prostrate and go for refuge.oṃ āḥ hūṃ vajra guru padma siddhi hūṃAt the time you suppressed the rākṣasas,You appeared as a young boy in the attire of a nirmāṇakāya,With a wondrous, beautiful form and a fine complexion.Your teeth are perfectly aligned, and your golden hair is beautiful,In the manner of a youth of sixteen years.Adorned with various precious jewel ornaments,In your right hand, you hold a kīla made of bronze,Suppressing the māras and rākṣasas.In your left hand, you hold a kīla made of acacia wood,Granting protection to your devoted children.Around your neck, you wear a kīla of iron;You are inseparable from the yidam deity,Non-dual nirmāṇakāya, Ornament of the World.Through your compassion, grant me your blessings.Through your love, lead me and others along the path.Through your enlightened intent, grant me the accomplishments.Through your power, dispel the obstacles for me and others.Dispel outer obstacles externally.Dispel inner obstacles internally.Dispel secret obstacles into the basic expanse.With devotion, I prostrate and go for refuge.oṃ āḥ hūṃ vajra guru padma siddhi hūṃWhen you directed your realization toward the land of spirits,Upon the ground in a valley of blazing fire,Within a lake the size of a bowshot,You appeared, cool and refreshing, upon a lotus.Within the lotus, you remained in meditative realization;You are renowned by the name Padmasambhava,Having appeared in person as a perfect Buddha.To such a wondrous nirmāṇakāya, I pray.Through your compassion, grant me your blessings.Through your love, lead me and others along the path.Through your enlightened intent, grant me the accomplishments.Through your power, dispel the obstacles for me and others.Dispel outer obstacles externally.Dispel inner obstacles internally.Dispel secret obstacles into the basic expanse.With devotion, I prostrate and go for refuge.oṃ āḥ hūṃ vajra guru padma siddhi hūṃWhen you acted as the sun of Tibet,You were the glory who leads faithful beings,Manifesting in whatever form was necessary to subdue them.At the summit of the Khala Pass in Tsang,You bound the drala lay-devotees under oath.In the region of Tsawa Tsashö,You bound the twenty-one arrogantLay-devotees of the gods under oath.At Jampatrin in Mangyul,You granted accomplishments to four monks.O supreme, most excellent Vidyādhara,Through your compassion, grant me your blessings.Through your love, lead me and others along the path.Through your enlightened intent, grant me the accomplishments.Through your power, dispel the obstacles for me and others.Dispel outer obstacles externally.Dispel inner obstacles internally.Dispel secret obstacles into the basic expanse.With devotion, I prostrate and go for refuge.oṃ āḥ hūṃ vajra guru padma siddhi hūṃOn the glorious plain of Palmotang,You bound the twelve Tenma goddesses under oath.At the Khala Pass in the land of Tibet,You bound the white snow-goddess Gangkar Shamé under oath.Before Lhabü Nying in Damshö,You bound Thangla Yarshü under oath.Upon the very summit of Hepori,You bound all the gods and demons under oath.Of all those great gods and demons,Some offered up their life-essence,Some pledged to protect the Teachings,And some pledged themselves as servants.They possess great power and miraculous might.Through your compassion, grant me your blessings.Through your love, lead me and others along the path.Through your enlightened intent, grant me the accomplishments.Through your power, dispel the obstacles for me and others.Dispel outer obstacles externally.Dispel inner obstacles internally.Dispel secret obstacles into the basic expanse.With devotion, I prostrate and go for refuge.oṃ āḥ hūṃ vajra guru padma siddhi hūṃWhen the teachings of the sublime DharmaWere hoisted like a victory banner,Samyé was spontaneously accomplished without being built,And the King’s intention was brought to final perfection.You were also addressed by the names of the three supreme beings:One is called Padmajungne,One is Padmasambhava,One is known as Lake-born Vajra,And your secret name is Dorje Drakpo Tsal.Through your compassion, grant me your blessings.Through your love, lead me and others along the path.Through your enlightened intent, grant me the accomplishments.Through your power, dispel the obstacles for me and others.Dispel outer obstacles externally.Dispel inner obstacles internally.Dispel secret obstacles into the basic expanse.With devotion, I prostrate and go for refuge.oṃ āḥ hūṃ vajra guru padma siddhi hūṃYou practiced at Samyé Chimphu,Averting adverse conditions and bestowing accomplishments.You established the king and ministers on the path to liberation,Suppressed the demonic Bön teachings,Revealed the precious, immaculate Dharmakāya,And established the fortunate on the level of Buddhahood.Through your compassion, grant me your blessings.Through your love, lead me and others along the path.Through your enlightened intent, grant me the accomplishments.Through your power, dispel the obstacles for me and others.Dispel outer obstacles externally.Dispel inner obstacles internally.Dispel secret obstacles into the basic expanse.With devotion, I prostrate and go for refuge.oṃ āḥ hūṃ vajra guru padma siddhi hūṃThen you departed for the land of Oḍḍiyāna.Now you act as the subduer of the rākṣasas.Surpassing all humans, you are a great wonder.With marvelous conduct, you are a great marvel.You possess great power and miraculous might.Through your compassion, grant me your blessings.Through your love, lead me and others along the path.Through your enlightened intent, grant me the accomplishments.Through your power, dispel the obstacles for me and others.Dispel outer obstacles externally.Dispel inner obstacles internally.Dispel secret obstacles into the basic expanse.With devotion, I prostrate and go for refuge.oṃ āḥ hūṃ vajra guru padma siddhi hūṃEndowed with body, speech, and mind, you are the glory who leads beings.Having abandoned all obscurations, you perceive the three realms with vivid clarity.Having attained supreme siddhi, you possess the body of supreme great bliss.You definitively dispel the obstacles to the attainment of enlightenment.Through your compassion, grant me your blessings.Through your love, lead me and others along the path.Through your enlightened intent, grant me the accomplishments.Through your power, dispel the obstacles for me and others.Dispel outer obstacles externally.Dispel inner obstacles internally.Dispel secret obstacles into the basic expanse.With devotion, I prostrate and go for refuge.oṃ āḥ hūṃ vajra guru padma siddhi hūṃoṃ āḥ hūṃ vajra guru padma thötreng tsal vajra samaya jaḥ siddhi phala hūṃ āḥ
